pages.title: Folding Chamber
pages.text: A thermostatted cuvette in a spectrometer, watching a protein chain fold into its shape, or fail to.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the temperature and the denaturant. The chain folds with ΔG = ΔH(1 − T/Tm) − m·U; the folded share 1/(1 + e^(−ΔG/RT)) must reach 95%. Warmer folds faster but nearer the melting point; below 278 K it aggregates.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Folded Protein Crystal, Prion Lattice.
